Free printables

Free food safety log templates (PDF)

8 printable logs built on the FDA Food Code limits: fridge and freezer, hot and cold holding, cooling, receiving, cleaning, sanitizer testing, thermometer calibration and time as a public health control. Print them, hang them on a clipboard, no email needed.

Fridge & freezer temperature log

Monthly sheet, 31 days, AM and PM readings, corrective-action column.

Hot & cold holding log

Steam tables, hot wells, salad bars and prep rails: time, item, temp, action.

Food cooling log

The 2-hour / 6-hour rule on one sheet, with checkpoints at 1, 2, 4 and 6 hours.

Receiving log

Delivery temps, supplier, condition and accept/reject for every drop.

Kitchen cleaning schedule

Weekly grid with daily, weekly and monthly tasks, sanitizer ppm and initials.

Thermometer calibration log

Ice-point and boiling-point checks for every probe, with the ±2°F limit printed on the sheet.

Sanitizer test log

Chlorine, quat or iodine ppm for every sink, bucket and dish machine, with the Food Code chart on the sheet.

TPHC log (time as a control)

Start time, starting temperature and discard time for food held on time instead of temperature.

Paper logs get lost, skipped and back-filled. ThermoTally is a phone app that reminds your team when a check is due, flags out-of-range temps on the spot, and turns a month of logs into one clean PDF for the inspector. Join the waitlist and tell us what you'd pay.
